sources.snippet: TLive-Omni is an omni-modal understanding model for e-commerce live-stream, mapping image, video, audio, and text into a unified text-output interface. Built on a Qwen3.5 backbone with a grafted AuT audio encoder, it supports 256K tokens of context, trained via a three-stage SFT recipe followed by Faithful-RFT reinforcement fine-tuning.

sources.title: TLive-Omni: An Omni-Modal Understanding Model for E-Commerce Live Streaming
sources.snippet: Abstract E-commerce live streaming requires omni-modal understanding of noisy, tempo-rally extended streams, where product facts are distributed across speech, video frames, product images, overlaid text, and user queries.
